ev.q: From 2016 to 2020, the percentage of residential care communities using electronic health records increased from 26% to 41%.
The change (from 12% to 14%) was not significant for 4–10 bed communities.
The percentage using electronic health records increased from 28% to 41% for 11–25 bed communities
The percentage using electronic health records increased from 28% to 41% for 11–25 bed communities, 35% to 54% for 26–50 bed communities
The change (from 12% to 14%) was not significant for 4–10 bed communities.
Source: National Post-acute and Long-term Care Study, 2016 and 2020 data.
